title: Carpeting the Room
statementMd:
Soroush's room is a square with side length $*n*$. Before this contest he bought $*k*$ fine Persian carpets to carpet his room for celebrating the $100$th contest on his favorite site. Each Persian carpet is a square of side length $*n*_{1}$.

Soroush wants to cover all the area of his room. Carpets can be put over each other but it is not allowed to rotate the carpets. Can Soroush carpet his room completely?

## Input

The input consists of three integer numbers $*n*$, $*k*$ and $*n*_{1}$ ($10 ≤ *n* ≤ 12$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10$, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/72f1942c84baf5bc0bba9b950b1605216412984e.png)).

## Output

Write a single `YES` or `NO`. Write `YES` if and only if Sorush can carpet his room completely.
statementZhMd:
Soroush 的房间是一个边长为 $*n*$ 的正方形。在这场比赛之前，他购买了 $*k*$ 张精美的波斯地毯，准备为庆祝他最喜欢的网站举办第 $100$ 场比赛而铺设房间。每张波斯地毯都是边长为 $*n*_{1}$ 的正方形。

Soroush 想要覆盖房间的全部面积。地毯可以相互重叠，但不允许旋转地毯。Soroush 能否完全铺满他的房间？

## 输入格式

输入包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$ 和 $*n*_{1}$（$10 ≤ *n* ≤ 12$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10$，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/72f1942c84baf5bc0bba9b950b1605216412984e.png)）。

## 输出格式

输出单独一行 `YES` 或 `NO`。当且仅当 Soroush 能够完全铺满他的房间时，输出 `YES`。
